newsitem.title: USA: ABC entertainment chief Harbert resigns.
newsitem.headline: ABC entertainment chief Harbert resigns.

text.p: ABC Inc Tuesday said Ted Harbert has resigned as chairman of ABC Entertainment.
Harbert was promoted to chairman in June when the network hired former NBC programming executive Jamie Tarses to the post of president of ABC Entertainment.
ABC is a unit of Walt Disney Co.
In a statement, ABC said Harbert's resignation is effective February 15.
Harbet, who joined ABC in 1977, said he intends to pursue new opportunities.

"I have spent nearly 20 years at ABC and I am extremely proud of my contributions to this wonderful company," Harbert said in a statement. "However, it is time for me to seek out new challenges and opportunities in the second half of my career, which I look forward to eagerly."
